actualDescriptor.plugin.yml:
name: GrimAC
version: 2.3.67
main: ac.grim.grimac.GrimAC
description: "Libre simulation anticheat designed for 1.21 with 1.8-1.21 support,\
  \ powered by PacketEvents 2.0."
author: GrimAC
permissions:
  grim.alerts:
    description: Receive alerts for violations
    default: op
  grim.alerts.enable-on-join:
    description: Enable alerts on join
    default: op
  grim.brand:
    description: Show client brands on join
    default: op
  grim.exempt:
    description: Exempt from all checks
    default: "false"
  grim.nomodifypacket:
    description: Disable modifying packets
    default: "false"
  grim.nosetback:
    description: Disable setback
    default: "false"
  grim.performance:
    description: Check performance metrics
    default: op
  grim.profile:
    description: Check user profile
    default: op
  grim.sendalert:
    description: Send cheater alert
    default: op
api-version: "1.13"
softdepend:
  - ProtocolLib
  - ProtocolSupport
  - Essentials
  - ViaVersion
  - ViaBackwards
  - ViaRewind
  - Geyser-Spigot
  - floodgate
  - FastLogin
folia-supported: true

limitations: Forge1.18.2 upstream Modrinth dependency list omits mandatory Architectury; actual descriptor dependency is included in the profile.
Fabric1.16.5 AntiXray requires Java16 or newer; Java17 profile is an untested separate experiment.
Four AntiXray118/119 binaries and Grim/Architectury omit a full license text; exact license/source URLs recorded for independent upstream downloads.
AntiXray116 metadata says CC0-1.0 but its embedded LICENSE and fixed source are MIT.
No legacy AntiXray config is auto-applied. Modern Grim punishment fragment is not staged for2.3.67.
No Forge1.16.5 AntiXray or old Fabric Grim artifact is selected; those integration gaps remain.
The legacy-grim-* key deliberately does not match manage_integrations.py startswith("grim-"); no modern punishment fragment was copied.
No stage is a complete server: Minecraft, exact loader, Verdict and its baseline dependencies are separate inputs.
Class version and descriptor checks are not startup, client compatibility, behavioral detection or ore-obfuscation evidence.
Grim2.3.67 is a historical release; current bypass resistance is not established by its Java8 bytecode.
Source descriptor correspondence is not reproducible-build proof. Architectury4.12 source family was checked; build94-to-commit identity remains unproven.
